run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T08:40:05Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend is backed by a real, step-like increase in frontend error spans: frontend ERROR span counts were 0 through 08:39:05Z and first became nonzero at 08:40:05Z, peaking around 1,084 per 5-minute window at 08:48Z-08:49Z, while frontend's total span volume stayed flat (~11.7k-13.9k per 5m), so this is not a traffic surge. The failing frontend operations are its AdService client path: grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, GET /api/data, the Next.js route 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and GET all show identical error counts, plus a small number of tcp.connect errors. The dependency behind them, the otel-demo ad service, is down: its only pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 is Running but not ready with restartCount 4 and its container last terminated with exitCode 137, reason OOMKilled (08:41:19Z) and is currently in a terminated OOMKilled state (08:42:21Z); the ad Deployment shows no ready/available replicas and the ad Service Endpoints contain only a notReadyAddress. That ad failure is not spontaneous: a Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh repeatedly spawned StressChaos experiments whose events record 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' between 08:39:10Z and 08:45:00Z, each recovered about 55s later, and the ad container runs with a 450Mi memory limit. So the alert is firing because injected memory stress on the ad container caused repeated OOM kills, leaving the ad service with no ready endpoint and making the frontend's GetAds / /api/data requests fail. frontend-proxy also shows its own error spans (ingress, 'router frontend egress') rising in the same interval; whether these are the same failed frontend requests is not verified. The remaining otel-demo pods were ready with zero restarts and the other traced services show only negligible error-span counts over the 30 minutes to 08:57:20Z. Trace-level evidence for the incident window itself is unavailable (Jaeger data ends at 08:30:21Z) and the Chaos Mesh Schedule/StressChaos specs could not be read with the available tools.

claims.text: Frontend spans with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR were 0 in every 5-minute window from 08:15:05Z through 08:39:05Z, then 156.67 at 08:40:05Z, rising to a peak of about 1,084 per 5m at 08:48:05Z-08:49:05Z; frontend's STATUS_CODE_UNSET span count stayed roughly flat (about 11.7k-13.9k per 5m) over the same period.

In the 10 minutes to 2026-11-17T08:57:20Z the frontend service recorded 276.87 ERROR spans versus 5,328.89 UNSET spans, and the error spans were distributed over exactly these operations: 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' 68.40, 'GET' 68.40, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' 68.40, 'GET /api/data' 68.40 and 'tcp.connect' 3.26.

The ad service emitted no spans at all in the 10 minutes to 08:57:20Z (ad ERROR = 0 and ad UNSET = 0 were returned as measured values), and its 5-minute span count fell from 456.67 at 08:40:05Z to 0 by 08:44:05Z and stayed 0; its few remaining error spans in the window were ~2 total over 30 minutes.

Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (owned by ReplicaSet ad-554b849958, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad) is phase Running but its container 'ad' is not ready: restartCount 4, lastState terminated with exitCode 137 and reason OOMKilled finishedAt 2026-11-17T08:41:19Z, and current state terminated with exitCode 137 and reason OOMKilled finishedAt 2026-11-17T08:42:21Z; the pod's Ready condition is False with reason ContainersNotReady.

All other 20 otel-demo pods are Running with ready true and restartCount 0 (flagd's two containers both ready), and every other otel-demo Deployment shows 1 ready / 1 available replica; the ad Deployment alone shows readyReplicas <none> and availableReplicas <none>.
The otel-demo Endpoints object named ad has no ready addresses: its only subset content is notReadyAddresses for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 on port 8080.

Events in namespace otel-demo for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 show container Pulled/Created/Started events with count 6 (lastTimestamp 2026-11-17T08:43:50Z) and a Warning BackOff event 'Back-off restarting failed container ad' with count 23 (lastTimestamp 08:46:58Z).

A Chaos Mesh Schedule named otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh spawned new experiment objects at 08:38:10Z (otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-jw6mq), 08:39:10Z (...-7n9mk), 08:40:10Z (...-8b272), 08:41:10Z (...-sh425), 08:42:10Z (...-w8tqb), 08:43:10Z (...-w4ct8) and 08:45:55Z (...-9ncrx), with Warning 'Forbid spawning new job' events in between.

StressChaos events in namespace chaos-mesh record 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' at 08:39:10Z, 08:40:10Z, 08:41:10Z, 08:42:11Z and 08:45:00Z, each followed by 'Time up according to the duration' and 'Successfully recover chaos' about 55 seconds later; later applies (08:42:10Z-08:46:23Z) failed with 'rpc error: code = Unknown desc = no running task found: task <container-id> not found'.
The ad Deployment defines one replica whose container 'ad' has memory limit 450Mi and memory request 225Mi (cpu limits 50m/10m).

container_memory_working_set_bytes for the ad container on pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 rose from ~331MB at 08:14Z to ~371MB by 08:39Z, then after the OOM kills a succession of new container IDs appears with low values (about 2.3MB, 49MB, 66MB, 123MB, 183MB, 189MB), consistent with repeated container recreation.

frontend-proxy's own ERROR spans were low background (about 1.1-4.4 per 5m) from 08:15:05Z up to 08:39:05Z, then rose to 76.67 at 08:40:05Z and about 500-538 per 5m through 08:52:05Z; over the 15 minutes to 08:57:20Z they are attributed to the operations 'ingress' (381.15) and 'router frontend egress' (377.83).

Over the 30 minutes to 08:57:20Z the only services with substantial ERROR span counts were frontend (2,260.71) and frontend-proxy (1,134.99); ad, fraud-detection and recommendation had ~2.06 each and accounting and payment had 0.

The current flagd-config ConfigMap in otel-demo lists fault-injection flags adFailure ('Fail ad service'), adHighCpu ('Triggers high cpu load in the ad service') and adManualGc, and every flag in the file has defaultVariant 'off' as read at query time.

Causal chain: the memory-stress StressChaos experiments spawned by Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress injected memory load into the ad container, pushing it past its 450Mi cgroup limit and causing the observed exitCode 137 OOMKilled terminations; with the ad pod unready and absent from the ad Service endpoints, the frontend's AdService/GetAds calls failed, which produced the GET /api/data and GET errors and the frontend error-rate alert. The container spec of the Schedule/StressChaos (stressor size, duration, selector) could not be read to confirm the memory amount.

frontend-proxy's 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' error spans and the pre-existing low background level of them reflect the same failed frontend requests, but the available span projection contains no error detail or parent references to confirm that link.

The flagd fault-injection flags adFailure/adHighCpu/adManualGc remain a candidate for ad-service faults, but the only values readable are the current ConfigMap (all 'off', read after the incident), so their value during 08:38-08:57Z is unknown; the observed ad container failure mode was memory OOMKilled, which matches injected memory stress rather than the failure these flags declare.

Have a human suspend or delete the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh to stop the repeated memory-stress injections on the ad container, then confirm the ad pod becomes ready and the ad Service endpoints repopulate.

Review the Schedule/StressChaos spec (stressor memory size, duration, target selector) and either reduce the injected memory or raise the ad container's 450Mi memory limit if the stress is meant to be survivable; also verify the ad readiness/liveness probe configuration that keeps the pod out of the endpoints while the stress runs.

gaps: Jaeger holds no trace data for the incident window: traces_search for service frontend over 08:39:00Z-08:50:00Z returned no_data, and the wider 07:40:05Z-08:57:20Z query hit RESULT_TOO_LARGE with a retained view whose source window ended at 2026-11-17T08:30:21Z (evidence_id 64a375e2-8028-4c1f-a047-74fb587ac3b5-t1:ad25c283-82b1-4b35-bcd6-255545b59d42, status error, not citable), so frontend/ad span error messages and parent-child call edges for the failures are unavailable.

The Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and the spawned StressChaos objects could not be read: their kind is not in the supported Kubernetes kind list, so the stressor type, memory size, duration and target selector are unverified and only their events were visible.
Container logs for the ad pod's previous instance are unavailable ('previous terminated container "ad" ... not found'), and the earlier restart/OOM times before 08:41:19Z are unknown.
fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx returned no_data (0 lines read, 0 bytes) for 08:30:00Z-08:57:20Z, so frontend application log lines for the failing /api/data requests were not verified.

The Prometheus rule named RequestErrorRate was not returned by list_prometheus_rules (no_data), so the alert's exact expression, ratio definition and lookback are unknown; only the Alertmanager annotation (current value 2.6222) was supplied.
The flagd flag values in effect during 08:38-08:57Z are unknown: only the current flagd-config ConfigMap state could be read, and change history is not an integrated data source in this Run.
next_steps: Inspect the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and its StressChaos children with Chaos Mesh tooling or kubectl access to record the stressor size, duration, schedule interval and pod/container selector.
Confirm with the platform owner whether this ad memory-stress experiment was intentionally scheduled, and if so adjust the ad memory limit or stressor size so the ad container is not OOM killed.
After the Schedule is suspended, re-check ad pod readiness, ad Service endpoints, ad span volume and frontend ERROR span rate to confirm the error rate returns to its pre-08:38 baseline.
